rule_text: 9.6 Interpretation of the Grades a. Fail grade: A student obtaining Grade F/FD/Ab shall be considered as failed and shall be required to register for the course again. In case of the elective courses, if the student does not want to register again in an elective course in which he/she has failed (for EG, ED, EO, FE courses but not for CC or FC courses), then he/she can register afresh for a new elective course. However, grades F/FD, as applicable, shall be mentioned in the Grade Card even after passing the course. b. 'FD' grade: The FD grade indicates fail due to shortage of attendance in a course. c. 'W' grade: This refers to the withdrawal from the courses other than core courses. Withdrawal shall be allowed as per the guidelines issued from time to time by the Dean Academics. d. Audit/FE courses: For audit courses, grades shall be indicated however this will not be counted for the computation of the SGPA/CGPA.
topic: F/FD/Ab count as fail and require re-registration
conditions: All courses
exceptions: Electives (EG, ED, EO, FE) may be replaced by a new elective; not CC/FC

document_title: Regulations for Undergraduate Programme of Bachelor of Technology (Regulations 2019-I(A)), NSUT
rule_text: 9.7 Computation of the SGPA and CGPA. a. The SGPA is the ratio of the sum of the product of the number of credits and the grade points scored in all the courses taken in a semester (including back-log courses), to the sum of the number of credits of all the courses taken by a student. b. The CGPA is also calculated in the same manner taking into account the best 162 credit courses of the student taken over all the semesters of a programme. c. The SGPA and CGPA shall be rounded off to 2 decimal points. d. CGPA shall be converted into percentage of marks by multiplying it with 10. Both CGPA and percentage shall be mentioned on the final transcript.
topic: Rounding of SGPA/CGPA
conditions: SGPA and CGPA

document_title: Guidelines for Mode of Registration for Student of Backlog Courses
rule_text: (a) Students who had met the attendance requirements in the semester when the course was originally registered may choose one of the following modes: I. Exam Only Mode (EOM): In this mode, students can appear directly for the Mid-Semester Examination (MSE) and End Semester Examination (ESE) without being required to attend classes again. Their previously earned Continuous Assessment (CA) marks will be carried forward. Further, provided the date of the exam doesn't clash with their current semester exam. II. Study Mode (SM): In this mode, students must register for the backlog course in the same semester in which it is offered to their junior batch as part of the regular curriculum, or during the summer semester if the course is available. Attendance is mandatory, and students must meet the required attendance criteria to be eligible for the examinations.
topic: Backlog Course Registration Modes: Exam Only Mode (EoM) vs Study Mode (SM)
conditions: Exam Only Mode is permissible ONLY if the student met attendance requirements during original course registration, and exam dates do not clash with current semester exams. Previously earned CA carried forward.
applicability: Students with backlog courses who met attendance requirements originally
source_section: GUIDELINES FOR MODE OF REGISTRATION FOR STUDENT OF BACKLOG COURSES

document_title: Guidelines for Mode of Registration for Student of Backlog Courses
rule_text: (b) UFM/Disciplinary action/Detention: Students who were debarred due to disciplinary action, involvement in unfair means (UFM), or shortage of attendance must re-register for the backlog courses in the semester when they are offered to their junior batch, or during the summer semester if available. These students are required to attend classes and satisfy the attendance requirements to qualify for the examinations. (c) Year-back Students: Students who got year back must re-register for the backlog courses in the semester when they are offered to their junior batch. These students are required to attend the classes and must meet the minimum attendance requirements in order to be eligible in the examinations.
topic: Mandatory Study Mode for Debarred, UFM, Attendance Detained & Year-Back Students
conditions: Students debarred for disciplinary, UFM, or attendance shortage, and year-back students, MUST take Study Mode with full class attendance. Exam Only Mode (EoM) is STRICTLY PROHIBITED for these students.
applicability: Students with disciplinary action, UFM, attendance detention, or year-back status
source_section: GUIDELINES FOR MODE OF REGISTRATION FOR STUDENT OF BACKLOG COURSES

document_title: Guidelines for Makeup Examination (Mid - End Semester for the Session 2025-2026)
rule_text: 1. Eligibility for Makeup Examination shall be limited to students who: a) Undertake official academic visits (Conference/workshop/training programme) to organizations, with prior approval of the Hon’ble Vice-Chancellor. b) Face serious illness/personal accident requiring hospitalization or experience a family calamity (self/parents/siblings). c) Are not detained due to shortage of attendance and have fulfilled the prescribed attendance requirements.
topic: Makeup Examination Eligibility Criteria
conditions: Limited strictly to approved academic visits with VC approval OR hospitalization / personal accident / family calamity. Student must NOT be detained due to shortage of attendance.
exceptions: Attendance detained students are strictly ineligible.
applicability: All students seeking makeup examination for missed MSE/ESE

document_title: Guidelines for Makeup Examination (Mid - End Semester for the Session 2025-2026)
rule_text: 2. Considering the tight academic schedule, Makeup Examinations for both odd and even semesters shall be conducted only once a year, during the Summer Semester, in Exam-Only Mode (EoM). 3. Students must submit an application to the Concerned Dean of the Faculty through their Head of the Department, along with the necessary supporting documents/certificates, within the stipulated period of five (05) days from the date of rejoining the University after illness.
topic: Makeup Exam Summer Schedule & 5-Day Application Deadline
conditions: Conducted only once a year, during Summer Semester, in Exam-Only Mode (EoM). Application must be submitted through HoD to Dean of Faculty within 5 days of rejoining after illness.

document_title: Guidelines for Makeup Examination (Mid - End Semester for the Session 2025-2026)
rule_text: 4. A Makeup Examination Scrutiny Committee (MESC) is constituted to examine and recommend. If satisfied with the merit of the case, may recommend permitting the student to appear in the Makeup Examination. In such cases, a transitory grade “I” will be awarded temporarily in the respective subject. 5. Recommendations require final approval of the Vice Chancellor (VC). 9. A student can register for the Makeup Examination in a maximum of two examination sessions of ODD Semester (Mid & End-2025-26).
topic: MESC Committee, Transitory 'I' Grade, and Maximum 2 Sessions Limit
conditions: MESC review and VC approval required. Transitory 'I' grade awarded. Maximum of 2 examination sessions permitted.

document_title: Schedule and guidelines for summer semester examination (May - July 2026), F. No. 220(591)/Summer Semester/2025-2026/Acad./NSUT/114, dated 08.05.2026
rule_text: 1. A student may register for a maximum of five backlog/improvement courses during the summer semester under Exam-only Mode (EoM) and/or Study Mode (SM) combined. Registration beyond five courses shall not be permitted. 2. Out of the total permitted courses, a maximum of two backlog/improvement courses may be registered under Study Mode (SM).
topic: Summer Semester Course Registration Limits (5 Total, Max 2 Study Mode)
conditions: Max 5 courses combined (EoM + SM). Max 2 courses under Study Mode (SM).
exceptions: Registration beyond five courses shall not be permitted.
applicability: All students registering for Summer Semester (May - July 2026)
source_section: B. Guidelines for the Summer Semester

document_title: Schedule and guidelines for summer semester examination (May - July 2026), F. No. 220(591)/Summer Semester/2025-2026/Acad./NSUT/114, dated 08.05.2026
rule_text: 3. The summer semester fee shall be Rs. 14,000/- per paper for Study Mode (SM) and Rs. 10,000/- per paper for Exam-only Mode (EoM).
topic: Summer Semester Fee Structure (SM vs EoM)
conditions: Rs. 14,000/- per paper for Study Mode; Rs. 10,000/- per paper for Exam-Only Mode.
applicability: All students registering for Summer Semester
source_section: B. Guidelines for the Summer Semester

document_title: Schedule and guidelines for summer semester examination (May - July 2026), F. No. 220(591)/Summer Semester/2025-2026/Acad./NSUT/114, dated 08.05.2026
rule_text: 4. For 8th semester B.Tech (final-year) courses, ensure that: a. The student has registered for 170 credits; and b. If the student has earned less than 162 credits and requires 4/8 additional credits to reach 162, the relevant backlog course must be offered to enable timely graduation.
topic: Final Year 8th Semester B.Tech Course Offering Guarantee
conditions: Student must have registered for 170 credits, earned <162 credits, and require 4 or 8 credits to reach 162 credits.
exceptions: Course must be offered by University to enable timely graduation.
source_section: B. Guidelines for the Summer Semester

document_title: Schedule and guidelines for summer semester examination (May - July 2026), F. No. 220(591)/Summer Semester/2025-2026/Acad./NSUT/114, dated 08.05.2026
rule_text: 11. A minimum of 75% attendance is mandatory, failing which the student shall not be allowed to appear in the MSE and/or ESE (as applicable). No relaxation in attendance shall be permitted. 12. A maximum grade of ‘A’ shall be awarded in courses offered during the summer semester.
topic: Mandatory 75% Attendance with Zero Relaxation & 'A' Maximum Grade Cap
conditions: Minimum 75% attendance mandatory in Study Mode. Strictly no relaxation allowed. Maximum grade awardable is 'A' (Grade Point 8).
exceptions: No relaxation permitted under any circumstance during summer semester.
applicability: All students registered in Summer Semester courses
source_section: B. Guidelines for the Summer Semester

document_title: Notice - Hostel & Mess Fee Submission for Ramanujan Hostel (BH-IV), No. NSUT/Ramanujan Hostel/Fee/2026/01, dated August 12, 2026
rule_text: This is to inform all the residents of Ramanujan Hostel (BH-IV) that the last date for submission of the Hostel and Mess Fee is 14th August 2026, 11 PM. Students are advised to ensure that the fee is deposited in the designated account(s) within the stipulated time. No extension of the deadline shall be entertained under any circumstances.
topic: Ramanujan Hostel (BH-IV) Fee Deadline and Allotment Cancellation Rule
conditions: Deadline: 14th August 2026, 11 PM. Failure to deposit either hostel or mess fee automatically cancels allotment.
exceptions: No deadline extension under any circumstances.

document_title: Notice - Illustrative List of Prohibited Items, No. NSUT/Ramanujan Hostel/Adm/2026/03, dated August 19, 2026
rule_text: The following items are prohibited inside the hostel premises: Electrical heaters, induction cookers, immersion rods, kettles (>1000W), ACs, toasters, microwave ovens; LPG cylinders, fuel, open-flame burners; fireworks; firearms, weapons, knives; alcoholic beverages, drugs, hookahs, vapes; sound systems, jammers; pets (dogs, cats, etc.); unauthorized furniture, water coolers, washing machines; hazardous chemicals; gambling equipment; unauthorized duplicate keys; drones, cameras without consent.
topic: Prohibited Items Inside Hostel Premises
conditions: Possession of any prohibited items is strictly banned inside hostel premises.
exceptions: Items specifically permitted in writing by Hostel Administration.

document_title: Notice - Illustrative List of Prohibited Items, No. NSUT/Ramanujan Hostel/Adm/2026/03, dated August 19, 2026
rule_text: General Rules: 1. Any prohibited item found in possession of a resident shall be liable to confiscation. Disciplinary action including monetary penalty, cancellation of hostel accommodation. 2. Playing indoor games or engaging in any recreational activity that creates noise or disturbs other residents is prohibited between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM. 3. Playing cricket, football, badminton, or any outdoor sport inside hostel buildings, corridors, staircases is prohibited.
topic: Hostel Quiet Hours (10 PM - 6 AM), Building Sports Ban, and Penalties
conditions: Quiet hours enforced between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM. Outdoor sports prohibited inside buildings and staircases.

document_title: Notice - Applications invited under CVSPK for D.O.E.P scholarship (Death Of Earning Parent) with DOEP application form, F. No. 84(344)/2026-27/DSW/NSUT/, dated 11/08/2026
rule_text: CVSPK-DOEP scheme is a running scheme that: a. Applies to those students, whose earning parent unfortunately expires while the student is pursuing a programme in NSUT. b. Provides full fee waiver for the remaining period of the programme. c. The filled up form and necessary documents must be submitted to the office of the dean student welfare within 90 days from the date of the death.
topic: CVSPK Death Of Earning Parent (DOEP) 100% Fee Waiver & 90-Day Submission Rule
conditions: Parent must expire while student is actively enrolled at NSUT. Application must be submitted to DSW within 90 days of death. Provides 100% fee waiver for remaining programme period.
applicability: All enrolled NSUT students who suffer the death of an earning parent

document_title: Notice - Applications invited under CVSPK for D.O.E.P scholarship (Death Of Earning Parent) with DOEP application form, F. No. 84(344)/2026-27/DSW/NSUT/, dated 11/08/2026
rule_text: Submit signed DOEP application form along with: a. Death Certificate of earning parents; b. Income certificate of Living parents for financial year 2026-27; c. Self-attested Student ID / CUMS Student Profile; d. Self-attested original cancelled cheque leaf / copy of first page of bank passbook of student's account. Physical submission in DSW office, Room 010 or 002 Admin Block by 25.08.2026 by 5:00 p.m. for current notice window.
topic: CVSPK-DOEP Application Documents and Notice Window Deadline (25.08.2026)
conditions: Mandatory documents must accompany 4-page signed form. Physical submission at DSW office.
applicability: Enrolled NSUT students applying under DOEP scheme
